title: Secondary voltage effective value
description: Essential: The student must correctly calculate the effective voltage across the secondary coil as 22 V.

title: Primary current reading
description: Essential: The student must correctly calculate the ammeter reading in the primary coil as approximately 0.273 A.

title: Primary voltage effective value
description: Important: The student must correctly compute the effective voltage of the primary source from its given peak value.

title: Transformer voltage ratio
description: Important: The student must correctly apply the turns ratio to relate primary and secondary effective voltages.

title: Power conservation application
description: Important: The student must apply power conservation (P_in = P_out) for the ideal transformer to find the primary current.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The student's final answers should include correct units (V and A).

title: Confusing peak with effective
description: Pitfall: Using the primary peak voltage (311 V) directly in the transformer ratio or power equation without converting to effective value.

title: Incorrect power equation
description: Pitfall: Using an incorrect formula (e.g., I1 = P2 / U2) to find the primary current, reversing the voltage transformation.
